categories.name: 前沿论文
categories.commentary: 这批论文集中在 Agent 的记忆与数据利用、推理效率与训练机制，以及视频生成的一致性问题上。

articles.title: ArchSpace: Recording, Reviewing, and Referencing LLM Architecture Research
articles.zh: ArchSpace：LLM 架构研究的记录、评审与引用
articles.summary: 如果你在追 LLM 架构这条线上层出不穷的改动，这类给研究本身搭建基础设施的工作值得留意，它针对的是实验结果难复现、改动难追溯的老问题。
articles.author: Jie Wang, Tong Zhu 等
articles.body: Model architecture shapes the scaling behavior, training efficiency, and inference cost of LLMs, making it a central focus of both industry and academia. In industry, teams such as those behind DeepSeek, Qwen, and Kimi routinely introduce architectural innovations, yet public reports rarely document which ideas succeeded, which were abandoned, and why. In academia, limited compute and inconsistent baselines often restrict evaluations to small-scale, single-point comparisons, making it difficult to establish whether improvements hold at larger scales or translate into broader impact. ArchSpace addresses both gaps as a public platform for Recording, Reviewing, and Referencing Architecture Researc}: each proposal is recorded with its experiments and reasoning, reviewed by the community, and referenced by later work. To evaluate ideas before costly large-scale training, ArchSpace leverages scaling laws to predict model loss at larger scales from smaller experiments, a practice widely adopted in industry. We provide initial references that make the platform usable: Qwen3.5 and OLMo3 baselines, fitted scaling laws, and a reusable training recipe. Ideas validated through this review can in turn become new baselines, and ArchSpace thereby aims to broaden the range of ideas that shape the next generation of models.
articles.bodyZh: 模型架构（model architecture）决定了LLM的规模扩展表现、训练效率和推理成本，所以它一直是产业界和学术界关注的核心。在产业界，DeepSeek、Qwen、Kimi背后的团队经常搞架构创新，但公开报告很少说清楚哪些点子成了、哪些被放弃、以及为什么。在学术界，算力有限、基线不统一，评估常常只能做小规模、单点比较，很难判断一个改进在更大规模上还成不成立，或者能不能带来更广泛的影响。ArchSpace 就是为了补上这两个缺口：它是一个公开平台，用来记录、评审和引用架构研究——每个方案都连实验和推理一起记录下来，由社区评审，并被后续工作引用。为了在大规模训练烧钱之前先评估想法，ArchSpace 借助缩放定律（scaling laws），用小规模实验预测更大规模下的模型损失，这也是产业界常用做法。我们还提供了一些初始参考，让平台一上来就能用：Qwen3.5 和 OLMo3 基线（baseline）、拟合好的缩放定律，以及一套可复用的训练方案（training recipe）。经过这套评审验证的想法，反过来又能变成新的基线；ArchSpace 也因此希望扩大那些能塑造下一代模型的想法范围。

articles.title: AgentSSL: Can MLE Agents Leverage Unlabeled Data?
articles.zh: AgentSSL：MLE Agent 能否利用无标注数据？
articles.summary: 如果你在做自动机器学习 Agent，这篇问了个很实际的问题：没有标签的时候，Agent 还能不能自己刨出有用的信号。
articles.author: Ethan Lin, Akanksha Sarkar 等
articles.body: Applying machine learning systems to new domains introduces bottlenecks in both labeled data acquisition and manual pipeline engineering. While recent MLE agents show promise in automating pipeline design, they have been studied almost exclusively in fully supervised settings, leaving them untested in realistic regimes where labeled data is scarce but unlabeled data is abundant. In this work, we introduce Agentic Semi-Supervised Learning (AgentSSL), framing SSL as a program search problem and studying how agents navigate this space under limited supervision. We find that even under weak feedback and matched compute, agents can synthesize code that combines and adapts established SSL techniques, exceeding the strongest human-engineered baselines in 8 of 12 settings by up to +21.8%. However, our results identify program selection as a critical bottleneck in AgentSSL, where performance drops by as much as 47% when selecting based on the agent's feedback metric. To systematically study this bottleneck, we introduce ProgramSelectBench, a large-scale benchmark with a combined total of 16,977 agent-generated and human-engineered SSL programs, and evaluate both unsupervised and active program selection methods. We further evaluate AgentSSL on real-world ecology detection tasks, highlighting the opportunities and challenges of transferring agent-discovered strategies beyond controlled benchmarks.
articles.bodyZh: 把机器学习系统用到新领域时，往往会卡在两个地方：一是有标签数据（labeled data）不好拿，二是人工搭建流程（manual pipeline engineering）太费劲。最近的 MLE 智能体（MLE agents，机器学习工程智能体）在自动化流程设计上看起来很有希望，但相关研究几乎都集中在全监督场景（fully supervised settings）里，还没在“有标签数据很少、无标签数据很多”这种更现实的条件下测过。在这项工作里，我们提出了智能体式半监督学习（Agentic Semi-Supervised Learning，简称 AgentSSL），把半监督学习（SSL）看成一个程序搜索问题（program search problem），研究智能体在监督信号有限时怎么在这个空间里摸索。我们发现，就算反馈很弱、算力也一样，智能体也能合成代码，把已有的 SSL 技术组合起来、做适配，在 12 种设置里有 8 种超过最强的人工设计基线，最高提升 21.8%。但结果也暴露出：程序选择（program selection）是 AgentSSL 里的关键瓶颈，如果按智能体自己的反馈指标来选，性能最多会掉 47%。为了系统研究这个瓶颈，我们推出了 ProgramSelectBench，这是一个大规模基准，合计包含 16,977 个由智能体生成和人工设计的 SSL 程序，并评估了无监督和主动式程序选择方法。我们还把 AgentSSL 放到真实世界的生态检测任务上评估，重点看智能体发现的策略能不能走出受控基准测试，以及这中间有哪些机会和挑战。

articles.title: Learning When Diffusion Language Models Should Regenerate
articles.zh: 学习扩散语言模型何时应当重新生成
articles.summary: 如果你在调 diffusion LM 的采样策略，"什么时候该推倒重来"现在基本靠拍脑袋，这篇想把它变成一个可学习的问题。
articles.author: Minhae Oh, Jeonghye Kim 等
articles.body: Remasking allows diffusion language models to revisit generated text, but effective correction requires knowing when and what to revise. Our diagnosis on Sudoku reveals two gaps. Hidden states contain error information that token confidence does not reliably expose, and remasking an isolated error usually reproduces it when the surrounding context remains fixed. These findings motivate DiVR , a verifier that predicts whether a partially generated sequence will reach a correct answer. Trained on the final correctness of the model's own trajectories, DiVR decides when to regenerate a block and which alternative to retain, while the generator itself stays unchanged. On five reasoning benchmarks with LLaDA-8B-Base, DiVR raises the average accuracy of the fine-tuned generator from 35.3\% to 43.4\% at $1.9$-$3.5\times$ the cost of greedy decoding, above search baselines that use $3.8$-$7.4\times$. It also complements post-training such as supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning, and generalizes to other generators, including Dream.
articles.bodyZh: 重新掩码（Remasking）能让扩散语言模型（diffusion language models）回头检查已经生成的文本，但想改得有效，得先知道什么时候该改、该改哪里。我们在数独（Sudoku）上的诊断发现两个缺口：隐藏状态（hidden states）里其实藏着错误信息，但词元置信度（token confidence）并不能可靠地把这些信息暴露出来；另外，如果只把某个孤立错误重新掩码，而周围上下文保持不变，通常还是会生成同样的错误。这些发现促成了 DiVR：一个验证器（verifier），用来预测一段只生成了一半的序列最后能不能得到正确答案。它用模型自己生成的轨迹最终对不对来训练，负责决定什么时候重新生成一整块、保留哪个备选，而生成器本身保持不动。在 LLaDA-8B-Base 的五个推理基准（reasoning benchmarks）上，DiVR 把微调后生成器的平均准确率从 35.3% 提高到 43.4%，成本是贪心解码（greedy decoding）的 1.9 到 3.5 倍，成绩还高于那些要用 3.8 到 7.4 倍成本的搜索基线（search baselines）。它还能和督微调（supervised fine-tuning）、强化学习（reinforcement learning）这类后训练（post-training）互补，也能泛化到其他生成器，包括 Dream。

articles.title: CoReMem: Cost-Internalizing Memory for Successive Coding Tasks with Prospective Valuation
articles.zh: CoReMem：面向连续编码任务、内化成本并带前瞻估值的记忆机制
articles.summary: 如果你让 Agent 连着做多个编码任务，记忆该留什么、丢什么一直是个坑，这篇把"存它的成本"和"以后还用得上"一起算进了取舍。
articles.author: Peiwen Li, Harshit Verma 等
articles.body: Coding agents tackle successive tasks on an evolving repository, carrying forward edits and writing memory before the next task is known. Selecting memory for unknown next tasks requires balancing future usefulness against the costs of writing and reading it. The actor must also decide when acting on available memory saves effort as the task unfolds. We introduce Coding-Repository Memory (CoReMem), a cost-internalizing framework that guides memory design and actor adaptation through measured memory value on the next task. Prospective segment valuation compares runs of the next task with and without individual trajectory segments from the same inherited repository state, guiding a compact memory built around anchors: repository locations and executable checks. Actor adaptation estimates on-policy memory value within rollout groups with and without memory, using a reward that prioritizes resolution and penalizes step count in successful runs. Provenance-gated value credit assigns the additional value term to steps identified as using memory-supplied anchors, while every step retains outcome credit. On ChainSWE, CoReMem raises the 27B actor's resolve rate from 21.0% to 25.7%, with 17% fewer steps and 11% fewer total cache-aware tokens, including memory-module calls, relative to the untrained actor model without memory.
articles.bodyZh: 编程智能体（coding agents）会在不断演化的代码仓库（repository）里接连处理任务，一边把改动往下传，一边在还不知道下一个任务是什么的时候先写记忆（memory）。要挑出对未知的下一个任务有用的记忆，就得在它未来的用处和写入、读取它的成本之间做权衡。执行器（actor）还得判断：随着任务展开，什么时候根据现有记忆行动能省力。我们提出 Coding-Repository Memory（CoReMem），一个成本内化框架（cost-internalizing framework）；它靠衡量记忆在下一个任务上的实际价值，来指导记忆怎么设计、执行器怎么适配。前瞻式片段估值（prospective segment valuation）会在同一个继承下来的仓库状态下，比较下一个任务在“带单个轨迹片段”和“不带单个轨迹片段”时的运行结果，从而指导构建一种紧凑记忆——它围绕锚点（anchors）来组织：仓库位置和可执行检查（executable checks）。执行器适配（actor adaptation）会在有记忆和没记忆的推演组（rollout groups）里，用同策略（on-policy）方式估算记忆价值；它用的奖励（reward）会优先看任务有没有解决，同时对成功运行里的步数进行惩罚。来源门控价值信用分配（provenance-gated value credit）会把额外的价值项记到那些被认定使用了记忆提供的锚点的步骤上，同时每一步都保留结果信用（outcome credit）。在 ChainSWE 上，CoReMem 把 27B 执行器的解决率（resolve rate）从 21.0% 提高到 25.7%；和没训练、也没记忆的执行器模型相比，步数少了 17%，总缓存感知 token（cache-aware tokens）数少了 11%，这里面还算上了记忆模块调用（memory-module calls）。

articles.title: Linking Rapid Learning to Compositional Structure in Neural Networks: Evidence from Additive Analogies in Meta-Learned Parameter Spaces
articles.zh: 将快速学习与神经网络的组合结构联系起来：来自元学习参数空间中加性类比的证据
articles.summary: 如果你关心模型为什么能举一反三，这篇从元学习参数空间里翻找组合结构的证据，属于纯机理研究，别指望直接拿去调模型。
articles.author: Abigail L. Tenenbaum, R. Thomas McCoy
articles.body: Humans can learn rapidly from limited experience, while neural networks typically require extensive training. In this work, we investigate what properties of a neural network can enable it to learn rapidly. We study neural networks that have been optimized via meta-learning, a technique that exposes a network to many related functions to facilitate its subsequent learning of similar functions. Prior work has shown that these meta-learned networks can learn new functions rapidly, but how they do so remains unclear. To investigate their internal structure, we take inspiration from classic work demonstrating additive relationships among the learned vectors that neural networks use to represent words (e.g., "king" minus "man" plus "woman" approximates "queen"). Analogously, we look for additive relationships among a meta-learned network's "representations" of different functions; when a meta-learned network rapidly learns to implement a specific function, all of its adapted parameter values can be concatenated into a single vector that we treat as representing the function. We find that such parameter vectors can be added and subtracted according to symbolic relationships among the functions they represent, yielding new parameter vectors that successfully represent the functions predicted by the corresponding symbolic manipulations: the networks specified by these artificially recombined vectors actually implement the intended functions without any direct training on them. Our results suggest that meta-learning can tune a network's starting point to organize subsequent learning along systematic, functionally meaningful trajectories through the space of possible parameter vectors, providing a geometric basis for realizing inductive biases in neural networks.
articles.bodyZh: 人类能从有限经验里学得很快，而神经网络通常得靠大量训练才行。在这项工作里，我们想搞清楚：神经网络到底得具备哪些性质，才能学得快。我们研究的是经过元学习（meta-learning）优化的神经网络；元学习就是让网络先接触很多相关函数，帮它之后更容易学会类似函数。之前的研究已经表明，这类经过元学习的网络能快速学会新函数，但它们到底是怎么做到的，还不清楚。为了看它们的内部结构，我们从一项经典研究里找灵感：神经网络用来表示词的向量之间存在加法关系，比如“king”减去“man”再加上“woman”，大约就等于“queen”。类似地，我们去找一个经过元学习的网络对不同函数的“表示（representations）”之间有没有加法关系；当一个元学习网络快速学会实现某个具体函数时，它调整后的所有参数值可以拼成一个向量，我们把这个向量当作对这个函数的表示。我们发现，这些参数向量可以按照它们所表示函数之间的符号关系（symbolic relationships）来做加法和减法，得到的新参数向量能成功表示对应符号操作所预测的函数：由这些人工重组出来的向量所指定的网络，实际上不用对目标函数做任何直接训练，就能实现想要的功能。我们的结果说明，元学习可以调整网络的起点，让后续学习沿着系统化、在功能上有意义的轨迹，穿过可能的参数向量空间，这就为在神经网络中实现归纳偏置（inductive biases）提供了几何基础。

articles.title: Sketching Language Models for Context Attribution
articles.zh: 用 Sketch 方法为语言模型做上下文归因
articles.summary: 如果你得说清模型这句输出到底引用了哪段输入，这篇想用近似手段把上下文归因做得更省算力。
articles.author: Christopher Liaw, Aranyak Mehta 等
articles.body: Context attribution asks how removing parts of a prompt changes a language model's output. We study leave-one-out (LOO) attribution for a prompt of $n$ tokens and a fixed measurement function. Computing all LOO values directly requires $n$ model evaluations. Under a stability assumption, our algorithm estimates all LOO values to error proportional to $\varepsilon$ with constant probability using $O(\sqrt{\log(1/\varepsilon)}/\varepsilon)$ evaluation calls. To complement our upper bound, we prove a matching $Ω(\sqrt{\log(1/\varepsilon)}/\varepsilon)$ lower bound on the number of evaluation calls in an oracle model. Empirically, we verify coefficient decay consistent with stability and evaluate the performance of our sketching algorithm on a small language-model retrieval task. Technically, our result is based on a sketching algorithm for arithmetic circuits whose Taylor coefficients satisfy the stability condition recently introduced by Gunn [Gun26]. A direct adaptation of their forward differentiation sketches would require $\widetilde{O}(\log(n)/\varepsilon^2)$ evaluation calls. Our key observation is that we can apply forward differentiation to the backpropagation circuit, with only constant overhead over a forward sketch of the same Taylor degree. This reduces the variance of the sketches and is key to our improved evaluation bound. Our lower bound builds on the techniques of Amsel, Chen, Duman Keles, Halikias, Musco, and Musco [ACDH+26, SIAM Journal on Matrix Analysis and Applications] for lower bounding the number of matrix-vector queries to estimate the diagonal elements of random matrices.
articles.bodyZh: 所谓上下文归因（context attribution），问的是：从提示词（prompt）里拿掉一部分内容，语言模型的输出会怎么变。我们研究的是，对一个有 n 个词元（token）的提示词和一个固定的测量函数（measurement function），怎么算所有留一法归因（leave-one-out attribution，LOO）值。直接算全部 LOO 值，需要做 n 次模型评估。在稳定性假设（stability assumption）下，我们的算法能以固定概率（constant probability）把所有 LOO 值都估到误差与 ε 成正比，而只需要 O(√log(1/ε)/ε) 次评估调用（evaluation calls）。为了补上我们的上界（upper bound），我们还证明了一个相匹配的下界（lower bound）：在 oracle 模型（oracle model）里，评估调用次数的下界也是 Ω(√log(1/ε)/ε)。在实验上，我们验证了系数衰减（coefficient decay）确实和稳定性假设相符，并在一项小型的语言模型检索任务上测试了我们这个素描算法（sketching algorithm）的表现。从技术上说，我们的结果建立在一个针对算术电路（arithmetic circuits）的素描算法上；这类电路的泰勒系数（Taylor coefficients）满足 Gunn [Gun26] 最近提出的稳定性条件。如果直接照搬他们的前向微分素描（forward differentiation sketches），需要 \widetilde{O}(\log(n)/\varepsilon^2) 次评估调用。我们的关键观察是：可以把前向微分用到反向传播电路（backpropagation circuit）上，而且比起同样泰勒阶数的前向素描，只多出常数级开销。这样能降低素描的方差（variance），也是我们改进评估次数上界的关键。我们的下界则建立在 Amsel、Chen、Duman Keles、Halikias、Musco 和 Musco [ACDH+26, SIAM Journal on Matrix Analysis and Applications] 的技术之上；他们那套技术用来给估计随机矩阵对角线元素所需的矩阵-向量查询（matrix-vector queries）次数做下界。

articles.title: Classical Energies Learn to Reason 1,000x Faster than Looped Models
articles.zh: 经典能量模型学推理比循环模型快 1000 倍
articles.summary: 如果你正被循环式、迭代式推理模型的算力开销劝退，这个结果提示换个参数化方式可能比堆层数划算，但"快1000倍"这种数先看清楚它对比的基线是什么。
articles.author: Benjamin Hoover, Hugh Blayney 等
articles.body: Looped models have emerged as a prominent paradigm for reasoning, with successes on simple reasoning puzzles such as Sudoku-Extreme and Maze-Unique. However, these models can be unstable, slow to train, and use many parameters and FLOPs to solve simple puzzles. Descent on an energy not only mitigates these issues but also offers advantages: built-in early stopping, compute that adapts to problem difficulty, fast training without differentiating through a solver, and interpretable weights that learn the constraints of the puzzle. Here we demonstrate this with a learned version of Hopfield & Tank's energy from the 80s, which we term CRAM, solves 99.996% of Sudoku-Extreme and 100% of Maze-Unique test puzzles after 42 ms and 132 ms of training on one GPU, at least 1,000x faster than looped models on these tasks. CRAM also matches baseline looped models at their highest accuracy on Sudoku-Extreme using at least 282x fewer inference FLOPs. Our work suggests two things. First, that energies are an extremely promising direction for training reasoning from data. Second, a caution against using trivially solvable benchmarks like Sudoku and Maze to test the scalability of looped reasoning techniques.
articles.bodyZh: 循环模型（looped models）已经成了推理领域的一个重要方向，在数独-极端（Sudoku-Extreme）和迷宫-唯一（Maze-Unique）这类简单推理谜题上都有不错表现。不过，这类模型不太稳定、训练慢，而且解简单谜题也要用很多参数和浮点运算量（FLOPs）。对能量函数做下降（descent on an energy）不仅能缓解这些问题，还带来一些好处：自带早停（early stopping），计算量能随题目难度自适应，训练快，不需要通过求解器（solver）做微分，权重也可解释，能学到题目的约束条件（constraints）。这里我们用 80 年代 Hopfield & Tank 能量函数的可学习版本做了演示，我们叫它 CRAM；它在单块 GPU 上分别训练 42 毫秒和 132 毫秒后，就能解出 Sudoku-Extreme 测试题的 99.996% 和 Maze-Unique 测试题的全部 100%，在这些任务上至少比循环模型快 1000 倍。CRAM 在 Sudoku-Extreme 上达到基线循环模型的最高准确率时，推理浮点运算量（inference FLOPs）至少少 282 倍。我们的工作说明两点。第一，能量函数是从数据里训练推理能力的一条极有前景的路。第二，也要提醒一句：别拿数独和迷宫这种太容易解的基准测试，来测循环推理技术的可扩展性（scalability）。

articles.title: Consistent Video-to-Video Translation via Explicit Correspondences
articles.zh: 基于显式对应关系的一致视频到视频翻译
articles.summary: 如果你在做视频风格化或视频编辑，帧间闪烁几乎是头号差评来源，这篇用显式对应关系来压一致性。
articles.author: Gaurav Parmar, Zhengqi Li 等
articles.body: Interactive video-to-video applications require real-time generation while maintaining long-range temporal consistency. However, recent methods achieve speed by restricting attention to a fixed-length causal window. This limits long-range consistency whenever relevant history falls outside the context window. To address this limitation, we introduce vid2vid-long, a correspondence-based approach grounded in a simple observation. Video-to-video translation provides an explicit cross-frame reference: the regions that match in the input video should match in the output video too. Concretely, we compute patch-level correspondences in the input, guiding retrieval of previously generated outputs in the corresponding regions, and condition the model on these patches through correspondence cross-attention. Our experiments demonstrate that vid2vid-long consistently improves long-range temporal consistency across recent video models while preserving generation quality and real-time performance.
articles.bodyZh: 做交互式视频到视频（video-to-video）应用，既要能实时生成，又得把长程时序一致性（long-range temporal consistency）稳住。可最近这些方法为了提速，只让模型盯着一个固定长度的因果窗口（causal window），结果一旦相关历史落在窗口外，长程一致性就拉胯了。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了 vid2vid-long：这是一种基于对应关系（correspondence-based）的方法，想法其实很简单——视频到视频翻译本身就给了我们一个跨帧的明确参照：输入视频里能对上的区域，在输出视频里也应该能对上。具体来说，我们先在输入里算图像块级对应关系（patch-level correspondences），用它们去引导检索先前生成结果中对应区域的内容，再通过对应交叉注意力（correspondence cross-attention）把这些图像块作为条件喂给模型。实验表明，放到最近的各类视频模型上，vid2vid-long 都能稳定提升长程时序一致性，同时不牺牲生成质量和实时性能。
